review.tagline: Reference stack for running OpenClaw, Hermes and Deep Agents in OpenShell sandboxes
review.summary: NemoClaw is a CLI-driven reference stack that installs a supported AI agent (OpenClaw by default, Hermes, or LangChain Deep Agents Code) inside an NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox. It adds guided onboarding, managed inference, network egress policy with operator approval, managed integrations and state persistence. The README labels it alpha.
review.audience: Self-hosters running agents like OpenClaw under sandbox and egress controls
strengths: Network policy with baseline rules, presets and operator approval for egress
Supports three agents: OpenClaw, Hermes and LangChain Deep Agents Code
Guided installer with express presets for DGX and WSL hosts
Official docs cover architecture, sandbox hardening and CLI commands
weaknesses: Labeled alpha; maintainer responses carry no guaranteed timelines
Depends on NVIDIA OpenShell as the sandbox runtime
Hardware and RAM requirements are only in external docs, not the README
needs: Models: OpenClaw, Hermes, LangChain Deep Agents Code
